ruleDefinitions.name: Mouse Movers and Jigglers
ruleDefinitions.description: This rule attempts to detect some of the most popular software Mouse Movers and Jigglers for Windows and MacOS.

sequences.name: Mouse Movers and Jigglers
sequences.query:
activity_type: "process-create" AND 
(
process_command_line: RGXi("MoveMouse Installer\.exe|Move Mouse Installer\.exe|MouseJiggle\.exe|Wiggler - The mouse moving app Installer\.exe|Caffeine\.exe|Insomnia\.exe|StayAwake\.exe|PreventTurnOff\.exe|DontSleep\.exe|NoSleep\.exe|StatusHolder\.exe") 
OR 
process_command_line: RGXi("Auto Mouse Jiggler Mover\.app|Jiggler\.app|Computer Mouse Jiggler\.app|Mouse Shaker\.app|Mouse Mover|pip install jiggler")
)
